features.statement: Page uses semantic HTML: footer element, article elements for cards, real button elements for CTAs, and small/label elements.
Quotes are marked up with blockquote and cite elements rather than figure/figcaption pairs.
Card titles sit at h3 beneath a parent h2 section heading, giving a nested heading hierarchy with meaningful text.
Typography uses a system font stack (-apple-system, Arial) rather than a proprietary brand typeface.
Section h2 headings are centered and navy-colored.
Body text is 16px with a 1.6 line-height, in navy-tinted dark with muted slate secondary text.
Card text and titles are left-aligned; card titles are sentence-case, semibold, navy rather than uppercase centered.
Intro paragraphs are centered in a narrow measure.
Palette uses brand blue sparingly, with dark navy and light cyan accents, and cyan highlights on arrows and CTAs.
Sections alternate white and pale blue-gray background bands, with a dark navy footer.
Primary CTAs are fully rounded pill buttons, with outlined pill secondary buttons inside cards rather than full-width bars.
Corners are generously rounded, with many pill and 8–16px radii instead of square corners.
Cards are white, rounded, with soft diffuse shadows and generous internal padding.
Layout uses CSS grid and a wide content column of about 1120px.
Header is a slim white bar with a small logo, overlapping the hero.
Search area is a compact select plus pill button inside a navy band beneath the hero.
Category links are presented as bordered tiles in a multi-column grid, each with an arrow icon.
People are shown as visible card grids with photo, name, title and location, and expanded profile cards with timelines.
Carousel pagination uses larger numbered circles with the active one filled.
Testimonials use a split layout with photo on one side and quote on navy on the other.
Social thumbnails are cropped to squares with rounded corners in a tight centered row.
Card images are cropped taller relative to width.
Alt text is empty for decorative images but descriptive for hero and people photos.
Small labels like 'Follow us' are uppercase with letter-spacing.
Footer is slim and minimal, with a single link and no dense legal text.
Copy uses typographic curly apostrophes.
Added subtitle microcopy precedes CTAs, such as an invitation line above an events button.
Markup is lean: few divs, scripts and classes, with one style block and minimal inline styles.
The html lang attribute names only the language without a region.
